readmeMarkdown:
# Notebook (`notebook-antigravity-plugin`)

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) A minimalist local notebook plugin running in the right-hand side pane of **Google Antigravity** (Antigravity 2.0, IDE, and CLI / `agy`). ## Quick Install ### Antigravity One-Line Install (Recommended) ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/Consyllus/notebook-antigravity-plugin ``` > Once installed, ask *"Open the notebook"* or type `/notebook` in chat to open the right-hand side pane. --- ## Key Features - **Live Block Editing & Markdown Formatting (`Ctrl+E`)**: Supports direct plain-text editing and toolbar formatting, as well as live Markdown block preview (`H1`–`H4` headings, **multi-level bullet, numbered, and task lists** with `• / ◦ / ▪` markers & auto-renumbering, code blocks, tables, and blockquotes) and instant raw source toggling. - **LaTeX Math Rendering & `0ms` Syntax Autocomplete**: - **Full Offline KaTeX Engine**: Supports inline `$...$` and centered display `$$...$$` math blocks (with live formula preview while editing source), bundled with `mhchem` chemical equations (`\ce{...}`), `physics`-style calculus/vector macros, cross-block `\gdef` custom macros, and `copy-tex` LaTeX source copying. - **Instant `\command` Autocomplete & Brace Tab-Jump**: Typing `\` inside any formula pops up a `0ms` completion menu across **950+ official KaTeX commands and environments** with live rendered symbol previews; press `Tab` / `Enter` to insert and land inside `{}` braces, and press `Tab` to jump across arguments (plus `￥￥` → `$|$` auto-conversion for Chinese IME). - **`@@` Context Selection Box (Two Mutually Exclusive Modes)**: Type `@@` in any line to spawn an upward-draggable selection frame and control exactly what the Agent sees: - **Mode A · Single-Turn Line Reference (Default)**: Sends only the file URI and line range for a single chat turn; the blue frame automatically turns gray once consumed. - **Mode B · Persistent Snippet Injection**: Injects only the selected plain text (zero file path or outside content exposure), staying active across turns with per-conversation SHA-1 deduplication to save tokens. - **Agent Access Locks (`PreToolUse` Engine Guard)**: - Independent toggles for **Allow Agent to Read Notes** and **Allow Agent to Edit Notes**. - **Dynamic Focus Busy-Lock**: Automatically pauses Agent writes while your cursor is focused inside the notebook with unsaved edits, resuming as soon as you save or move focus away. - **Multi-Note Management & Flexible Storage**: - Create, search, switch, inline-rename, and delete notes with automatic local saving. - Follows `/notes` by default, or points to any fixed local folder via the built-in directory browser. - **Host-Synced Theme Colors & Bilingual UI**: Automatically syncs background surfaces, text, borders, accent colors, and math formula rendering with the Antigravity host's Light / Dark theme in real time, with built-in English and Simplified Chinese switching. ## Keyboard Shortcuts | Shortcut / Trigger | Action | | :--- | :--- | | `@@` | Spawn context selection frame at current block; drag upward to select range | | `\` + letters (in math) | Open `0ms` LaTeX command/environment autocomplete (`Tab` / `Enter` to insert & jump `{}` args) | | `￥￥` (Chinese IME) | Auto-convert to `$$` and place cursor right in the middle | | `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` | Indent / outdent bullet, numbered, or task list items | | `Enter` / `Backspace` | Continue current list level; outdent step-by-step on empty nested items | | `Ctrl+S` / `Cmd+S` | Save current note immediately | | `Ctrl+E` / `Cmd+E` | Toggle between Live Preview and Raw Markdown Source | | `Ctrl+B` / `Cmd+B` | Bold selected text | | `Ctrl+N` / `Cmd+N` | Create a new note | ## Alternative Installation ### Manual Clone (Antigravity App / IDE) **Windows (PowerShell)** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Consyllus/notebook-antigravity-plugin.git "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\md-notes" ``` **macOS / Linux** ```bash git clone https://github.com/Consyllus/notebook-antigravity-plugin.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/md-notes ``` > For workspace-only installation, clone into `.agents/plugins/md-notes` inside your project root. ## Credits & License - **Organization**: [Consyllus](https://consyllus.com) - **Author**: FalsenJing - **License**: [MIT](./LICENSE)
latestReleaseNotes:
Adds full offline **KaTeX** math formula rendering, **`0ms` `\command` syntax autocomplete**, and Chinese IME math input helpers to **Notebook** (`notebook-antigravity-plugin`).

### What's New
- **Full Offline KaTeX Math Engine (`katex@0.19.1`)**:
  - Supports inline `$...$` / `\(...\)` and centered display `$$...$$` / `\[...\]` math blocks with **live formula preview** while editing source (and Markdown/table-pipe protection).
  - Bundled with base64-inlined `.woff2` fonts (zero external CDN requests), **`mhchem`** chemical equations (`\ce{...}`), **`physics`**-style calculus/vector macros (`\dd`, `\dv`, `\pdv`, `\grad`, `\norm`, etc.), cross-block `\gdef` / `\newcommand` macro persistence, and **`copy-tex`** (copying rendered formulas outputs raw LaTeX source).
- **LaTeX Syntax Autocomplete**:
  - Typing `\` inside any formula opens an instant completion popup across **950+ official KaTeX commands and environments** with live rendered symbol previews.
  - Press `Tab` / `Enter` to insert and land directly inside `{}` braces, and press `Tab` to jump across arguments or exit delimiters.
- **Chinese IME Math Input Helpers**:
  - Typing `￥￥` (or `¥¥`) automatically converts to `$$` with the cursor placed in the middle (`$|$`); typing `￥￥` again upgrades to `$$|$$`, and `、` inside math auto-converts to `\`.
- **Docs**: Highlighted real-time Antigravity host Light / Dark theme color syncing and new math shortcuts in `README.md` & `README.zh-CN.md`.

---

### 更新（简体中文）
- **离线完整版 KaTeX 数学引擎**：支持行内 `$...$` 与居中块级 `$$...$$` 公式（编辑源码时下方同步实时预览），内置 `.woff2` 离线数学字体、`mhchem` 化学方程式、常用 `physics` 微分/向量算符、跨块 `\gdef` 自定义宏，以及 `copy-tex` 选中复制公式源码。
- **数学语法自动补全**：公式内输入 `\` 即刻弹出 **950+ 个官方命令与环境**候选框（附实时符号预览），按 `Tab` / `Enter` 补全并落位至 `{}` 内，连续按 `Tab` 依次跳空。
- **中文输入法优化与文档完善**：连按 `￥￥` 自动转为英文 `$$` 且光标居中（再按升级为块级公式，公式内误敲顿号 `、` 自动转 `\`）；补充宿主浅色/深色主题实时跟随说明。

### Quick Install / Update
```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/Consyllus/notebook-antigravity-plugin
```

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Consyllus/notebook-antigravity-plugin/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0
